classifications.classification: Credited proving files = proving_file of PROVED* PCUF_ALL_STATUS records with a correct basis (117 files, 503 definitions) plus the P4b/P4c final PRVEq files (10 files, module-level records). Files that declare a common fully-qualified name (prov-p2a NativeFunsQ415 vs p2f RPz7_FIo_NativeFuns; p2f vs p3a RPu_FIq_Native08; p2f vs p4a S8OwnedP6_Funs) go in different bundles; no renaming (renaming a gate-namespace file changes name resolution). Consequence: no single combined environment; 12 bundle scopes. Wrong-basis theorems (177 proved definitions with a basis problem) are not audited and carry no credit.

classifications.classification: PCXA_L006 (bundle A6, 20 files) exit 1: the S8OwnedP6 from_residual theorem of prov-p4a eq/PRVEq_S8OwnedP6_Funs.lean did not close in the bundle context (it passes alone, L011, 97 s). Shape changed: A11 = that file alone, A12 = A6 without it. L006 is retained as a failure record and not rerun unchanged. 12 Lean scopes used (L001-L012), 0 extraction, 0 Kani. The bundle-context dependence is unexplained and is a limit: that theorem is credited from the standalone scope.

The cone list is the ledger30-walker output NNH_L942 (146370 constants), reused and sha256-verified (0b316cbb...), not recomputed: same pinned walker binary NNM_ProofDriver 46ee271b, same root. PCWD_ReachMeta2 was not needed. The brief asked to compute with the walker; reuse of an identical-input pinned output was classified as equivalent and recorded.

Same rule as PCO_partition.py stage_hits (re-run at 6ce07a6a593 reproduces module groups and row counts; one module, AspisR1WideToBytesSource.Funs, differs only by the PCO pilot/shadow correction). 209 emitted modules in the cone. Unannotated hand-written/auxiliary names reached are counted but not given a provenance status.

EQUALITY_PROVED = PCUF PROVED_RFL/UNFOLD/EQUIV/P3 with a correct basis (P3 = nominal/source-shape transport) or a P4b/P4c audited equality with a compatible basis. EQUALITY_DOMAIN = the 4 PROVED_P3_LOOP_REFINEMENT definitions (a refinement, not a plain equality); no canonical-domain (M31.add-class) equality exists. OPEN = everything else including every record whose only basis is wrong (ruling a). TEXT_IDENTICAL_ONLY with a correct basis is OPEN. RECEIPTED = module in PCO group R (hash-linked extraction receipt); its overflow configuration is not re-derived.

Required configuration is the PCUF value (ON unless a CONFIG_MISMATCH result showed OFF; 10 definitions). An independent text detector classifies bodies as WRAPPING/CHECKED/MIXED/NO_ARITHMETIC; 38 definitions that PCUF treats as ON carry explicit wrapping_* calls (configuration-independent: they match either emission). For P4b/P4c extras, extraction configuration was read from the PINS environment (NHV, NJT: OFF; Multiproof, archive packets: ON) and an OFF-extraction equality of a CHECKED body is counted OPEN.

R22 (design/R22-OVERFLOW-20261021.md) owns checked-to-wrapping; its packet cites frozen source b2727acd..., not 4bb3b3f: the pin difference is noted and not reconciled here. The split is by body class; provenance does not discharge it.

Comparison is by source sha256, not by object: L187 compared declarations (the .olean embeds the invocation path), and this job ran no object comparison. L187_SOURCE_FIXES.jsonl was read from branch codex/cx-integrate-20261107 because it was not on research when read.

A heuristic union: explicit hand_model flags, Aeneas-generated flags and a text test (no Source: doc comment). It is a classification of campaign records, not an audit of model bodies; entries with no gate definition found are unresolved externals, not models.
Sibling P1f (PCQG_) emissions and any later status were not used (none announced when this snapshot was built).
